description: Without id: lists Clear Tape's eleven preset trading systems (trend, breakout, momentum and volume) with their style, holding period and one-line entry, stop and exit. With id: one system's exact written rules (entry, stop, exit, target, parameters, the data it needs, terms, where it differs from the published method), its strengths, weaknesses, who it suits and its sources, worded exactly as on its strategy page. Rules only: no signals, no prices, no performance figures. Educational, not investment advice.

id.description: The system to describe; leave out to list them all.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).
